$comment: Monorepo: CRA frontend at repo root + Express API (server/) as a serverless function at /api/*. The function imports the app from server/src/app, so both root and server deps must be installed and the Prisma client generated (Postgres provider) before the frontend build bundles the function.
buildCommand: node server/scripts/set-provider.js postgresql && cd server && npx prisma generate && cd .. && npm run build
